notes.title: Sipssassin V0.0.168 - Coffee Shop Level Completely Revamped!
notes.notes:
Practically rebuilt from the ground up, this latest build features:
- new drink temperature hazard mechanics
- a more robust cover/detection system
- walking NPCs
- randomized drink placement
- a quest
- a dialogue system
- dynamic button icons
- more rooms

notes.title: Sipssassin V0.0.86 - Coffee Shop Level Playtest
notes.notes:
- Removed character toggle after further testing proved it to be confusing
- Added more interactable objects that enable more emergent stealth options
- Added a new disguise ability
- Tweaked enemy difficulty
- Added an alert system for NPCs to alert enemies
- Fixed known bugs
